Subject: FinBank - KMS & encryption follow-up

Hi Alice 

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap and the items we said we'd follow up on after the call: 

1) High-level answers on encryption and KMS support
   - At-rest: data encrypted with AES-256. Model artifacts and persisted KV caches are encrypted at rest.
   - In-transit: all RPCs and customer-facing endpoints use TLS 1.3 (mutual TLS available for private deployments).
   - Customer-managed keys (BYOK): supported via cloud KMS integrations (AWS KMS, GCP KMS, Azure Key Vault) and can be configured for envelope encryption.
   - HSM-backed keys: supported through customer cloud HSMs and by importing HSM-backed keys where customer policy requires hardware root of trust.

2) Compliance/status:
   - SOC 2 Type II: Redwood maintains SOC 2 Type II and can share the report under an NDA; we can provide the latest report or a SOC 2 summary artifact.
   - GDPR/HIPAA: We support data residency and can run private deployments for regulated workloads; we have Business Associate Agreement (BAA) options for HIPAA scenarios.

3) Vendor security questionnaire / evidence
   - You mentioned a vendor questionnaire during the call  we'd be happy to start that. Can you send the questionnaire file and any required SLA/contract redlines?

Next steps:
- Please send the vendor questionnaire (if available)  I can route internally and work with Marissa/Aditya to fill it out.
- I'll attach our KMS whitepaper and a pre-filled vendor security questionnaire template to speed the process.
- Would you be available for a 30-min follow-up next week to go over any outstanding technical questions?

Attachments: Redwood_KMS_whitepaper.pdf, Vendor_Security_Questionnaire_Redwood.xlsx

Thanks,

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>

Date: Tue, 13 Jul 2026 15:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: FinBank - KMS & encryption follow-up (draft answers)

Camila / Aditya,

Draft answers to the FinBank questionnaire items Camila listed above. I put concise language that we can paste into their XLSX. I also noted items that will require legal/ops sign-off (SOC 2 distribution under NDA, BAA for HIPAA).

Key storage (hosted):
- We support both Redwood-managed keys and customer-managed keys (CMK) via cloud KMS providers (AWS KMS, GCP KMS, Azure Key Vault). For CMK we use envelope encryption: model/data encryption keys are encrypted with a CMK managed in the customer's cloud project/account.

HSM / FIPS:
- HSM-backed keys are supported via customer cloud HSM offerings (e.g., AWS CloudHSM, GCP Cloud HSM). For customers requiring FIPS-validated hardware, we recommend deploying keys in their HSM and configuring CMK integration.

Key rotation & deletion:
- Rotation: customers can trigger rotation in their KMS; envelope keys are re-wrapped. We support scheduled rotation policies and can assist operationally.
- Deletion: upon termination, customers can revoke/delete the CMK in their cloud KMS which renders data inaccessible; we provide support for key escrow/transfer scenarios for private deployments if needed.

SOC 2 / Evidence:
- SOC 2 Type II report is available under NDA. We can provide a SOC 2 summary and a secure share link once the NDA is complete.

Data residency:
- Hosted: workloads can be pinned to cloud regions where we operate (we maintain multiple regions across US/EU/APAC).
- Private: for strict residency needs we offer private VPC/on-prem deployments. Backups follow the same residency constraints as the primary data; export procedures are documented in our runbook.

Attachments: Redwood_KMS_whitepaper.pdf, Vendor_Security_Questionnaire_Redwood.xlsx

Notes / open items to confirm with Legal/Ops:
- Exact NDA workflow for SOC 2 share (who signs on FinBank side).
- Whether FinBank requires a BAA (HIPAA) or additional controls mapping.

If you want, I can pre-fill the workbook and send it back to Alice this afternoon.

Marissa

Thanks for sending the questionnaire. I've attached our pre-filled responses (Vendor_Security_Questionnaire_Redwood.xlsx) and our KMS whitepaper for additional context (Redwood_KMS_whitepaper.pdf).

Quick answers to your top bullets from the security team:
- Keys: we support both Redwood-managed and customer-managed keys. For customer-managed keys we recommend envelope encryption with the CMK in the customer cloud account.
- HSM: supported via customer cloud HSM; we can document FIPS requirements separately if needed.
- Rotation & deletion: rotation handled via customer KMS; deletion of CMK renders wrapped data inaccessible. We'll outline deletion/escrow options in the questionnaire where applicable.
- SOC 2: we can share the SOC 2 Type II report under NDA. If you confirm the preferred recipient for the NDA, I'll route to Legal and share a secure link.
- Data residency: we can pin workloads to US regions for FinBank; private deployments are available for stricter controls.
